versionPolicy: Every independently reviewable implementation, bridge, infrastructure, or deployment-configuration change receives a new NORTHSTAR micro-version and its own changelog entry.

releases.title: Document Studio — interaction lifecycle and faithful text export
releases.description: Closes editor page-level hover listeners on unmount, preserves touch selection while using contextual text formatting, clears hover targets correctly, and improves PDF export for bulleted/numbered lists, paragraph spacing, justified text, and supported punctuation glyphs. Adds regression coverage for teardown and list conversion.
releases.status: Automated checks and deployment are recorded by the corresponding GitHub Actions release run.

releases.title: Document Studio — editable text-object foundation
releases.description: Replaces the one-shot text-entry workflow with direct on-page text objects. Adds a separate DOM text layer, create/select/edit flows, move and resize handles, typography controls, rich-text markup persistence, Pencil hover cursor and placement previews, and formatted PDF export using supported PDF standard-font families.
releases.status: Deployed to production and preview. GitHub Pages workflow run 45066524340 completed successfully for main commit a861a645cd0ce41dab60c06439b007ce470c09c3.

releases.title: Two-finger navigation pointer capture
releases.description: Captures both touch pointers during two-finger document navigation and preserves the selected input model while the gesture completes. Verified in the Phase 4 automated workflow.
releases.status: Automated Phase 4 workflow passed; physical Pencil hardware acceptance remains separate.

releases.title: Input mode persistence and tool independence
releases.description: Separates Hand/Finger and Apple Pencil input selection from the active annotation tool. Tool selection no longer silently changes the input mode, and the input choice persists when another PDF is opened.

releases.title: All annotation tools in both input modes
releases.description: Introduces a shared pointer/tool capability model so the supported annotation tools can be used with finger or mouse in Hand mode and Apple Pencil in Pencil mode. Adds mode/tool regression checks.

releases.title: Native assignment workspace and PDF Document Studio
releases.description: Introduces the in-dashboard assignment route, Canvas attachment retrieval, PDF.js rendering, page-level annotation tools, local annotation persistence, undo/redo, and flattened annotated-PDF export.
